answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 810 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the karst log makes public the live set and the echo audit records each lapse. Keeping 61 aliases alive therefore means 61 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ivory quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
